instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Tell me what changed between two versions of a diagram: boxes and arrows added, removed or changed, and what changed on each", and give it before; after.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:compare-two-diagrams and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes a before and an after, each with boxes (an id, and optionally a label, a size, a lane and a style) and arrows (from, to, an optional id and label).
